summary: Apollo Asset Backed Credit Co. LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of multiple share classes (Series I and II) under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S, and disclosed net asset values per share as of May 31, 2026. No pricing, premium, or takeover terms are present. This is a routine periodic disclosure of capital raises and NAV, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change.
